title: Prompt box head peeks: the selected model's mascot peeks over the box now and then
description: Under umbrella MPI-846; MPI-777 Phase 4B, split out on closing it (Fabio, 2026-09-24). A ledge on MpiPromptBox's top edge, bottom-aligned, hiding the lower part of the peek behind the box edge (the landing ledge in MpiAgentChat.js _COSMO_LEDGE is the working pattern). On model selection the selected model's mascot (image -> Prism, video -> Reel ...) plays its peek once, then returns now and then at a random spot in a fixed central zone clear of the image chips and operation buttons. The peeks for vision/prompt/video/audio are staged and never shown. BLOCKED: MpiPromptBox.js/.css held by stale claim 131f8d6c (message 2568a53a unanswered). Verify: user-ux, Fabio in each mode.
